questions.q_en:
Parts of a sentence are given below. While the first and the last parts (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the parts in between are jumbled up. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent sentence.

S1) The development of septicemia

A) contracted an infectious disease

B) indicates that the infectious process

C) following surgery or after the patient has

D) has escaped the control of the body's immune system

S6) and requires immediate medical intervention.
questions.solution_en:
The correct order to form a coherent paragraph/sentence is CABD. S1 introduces the topic of septicemia, setting the context for what will be discussed in the sentence. Part C provides additional information about the circumstances under which septicemia can occur/develop, adding detail to the context provided in the introductory sentence. Part A follows the context provided in part C and specifies that it can also occur/develop in patients who have contracted an infectious disease. Parts B and D follow logically, explaining that the development of septicemia indicates something. It indicates that the infectious process has escaped the control of the body's immune system. These parts explain the severity of the situation, stating that the infectious process has overwhelmed the body's immune system. Finally, S6 concludes the paragraph by emphasising the urgency of the situation, indicating that septicemia demands immediate medical attention due to the severity of the condition.

Parts C and A form an essential logical pair. So, they should be placed together. Part C provides contextual information about the scenarios in which septicemia might occur. It sets the stage by mentioning situations like post-surgery or after the patient has suffered something. Part A completes the thought presented in part C by specifying what the patient has suffered (an infectious disease). In option (a), C and A are placed together. Hence, (a) is the correct answer.

The sentence formed is: The development of septicemia following surgery or after the patient has contracted an infectious disease indicates that the infectious process has escaped the control of the body's immune system and requires immediate medical intervention.

Then, C and B follow and lastly, A serves as the concluding sentence as the doctor concluded that the author might have been infected with a virus.

Therefore, the correct answer is (c), DCBA.

A. As a discipline that celebrates individuality and self-expression, fashion designing remains vibrant.

B. The ever-evolving nature of fashion demands designers to stay attuned to emerging trends, technological advancements, and sustainable practices.

C. Beyond the runway, these visionaries shape the commercial landscape, influencing retail and marketing strategies.

D. From haute couture to ready-to-wear, fashion designers cater to diverse tastes and lifestyles, contributing to the rich tapestry of global style.

E. Fashion designing is not merely about clothing; it's a form of artistic expression that reflects and responds to the cultural zeitgeist, making it an integral and continually evolving aspect of our lives.
questions.solution_en: B introduces the idea that fashion is constantly changing, and designers need to keep up with various factors. It sets the stage for discussing the role of fashion designers in the industry. Following the introduction of the dynamic nature of fashion, D elaborates on the diverse range of styles and tastes that fashion designers cater to. It expands on the idea introduced in sentence B. Now, in C, the focus shifts from the creative aspect of fashion to its commercial impact. Fashion designers are not just artists; they also play a crucial role in shaping the business and marketing aspects of the industry. E further emphasizes the artistic and cultural significance of fashion designing. It completes the narrative by connecting fashion to broader cultural contexts, suggesting its integral role in our lives. The final sentence, A serves as a concluding statement, summarizing the overall theme. It brings the focus back to the creative aspect of fashion, emphasizing its vibrant and individualistic nature. So, the correct order is BDCEA, as it follows a logical progression from the dynamic nature of fashion to the diverse style designers cater to, their commercial impact, the artistic expression in fashion, and finally, a concluding statement on the vibrancy of fashion as a discipline. Hence, (b) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

The supervisor said to the staff, "Make sure that every room is disinfected properly."
options_en: The supervisor instructed the staff to make sure that every room was being disinfected properly.
The supervisor instructs the staff to make sure that every room is disinfected properly.
The supervisor instructed the staff to make sure that every room was disinfected properly.
The supervisor instructed the staff to make sure that every room had been disinfected properly.
questions.solution_en:
Imperative Sentences are used to demonstrate Request, Order, Command, etc.

Imperative Sentences begin with Principal verbs like Go, Make, etc.

The reporting verbs like "said", "say", etc. in direct speech are changed into "begged", "beg", etc.

"To" is used before the Principal Verbs in the Indirect Speech.

For example:

John said to his assistant, "Bring me a glass of water." (Direct Speech)

John ordered his assistant to bring him a glass of water. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

'Said to' will be changed to 'instructed'.

'To' will be introduced in the sentence.

Simple present tense verb construct ('is disinfected') will be changed to Simple past tense verb construct ('was disinfected').

Therefore, the correct answer is option (c): The supervisor instructed the staff to make sure that every room was disinfected properly.

questions.q_en:
Directions [Set of 4 Questions]:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.

The World Health Organisation (WHO) says these antibiotic-resistant "superbug infections" pose a major "global threat" to public health. Such resistance directly caused 1.27 million deaths worldwide in 2019, according to The Lancet, a medical journal. The toll is projected to rise to 10 million deaths per year by 2050, says the WHO. Antibiotics - which are considered to be the first line of defence against severe infections - did not work in most of these cases. India has the highest rate of human antibiotic use in the world. Antibiotic-resistant neonatal infections alone are responsible for the deaths of nearly 60,000 newborns each year. Researchers say the use of antibiotics was exacerbated during the Covid-19 pandemic. The weeks-long Kumbh Mela occurs in four Indian cities. The pilgrims take a holy dip in the river waters on the banks of the cities where the festival is held. The US-based researchers gathered data from some 70,000 patients who turned up at more than 40 clinics at two editions of the festival in 2013 and 2015 held in the cities of Prayagraj - also known as Allahabad - and Nashik.

More than 100 million pilgrims attended the two festivals. In Prayagraj in 2013, the patients had a median age of 46 years and most of them were men. Their common symptoms included fever, cough, runny nose, muscle pain, and diarrhoea. Researchers found that more than a third of patients at the clinics were prescribed antibiotics. In Prayagraj, nearly 69% of the patients reporting upper respiratory tract infections received antibiotics at the free state-run clinics at the festival site. "This is an alarmingly high rate, given that the vast majority of upper respiratory tract infections are viral in nature," the researchers say in a recently published paper. Researchers found that entering a clinic at the Kumbh Mela for any reason carried a one-in-three likelihood of walking out with a prescription for antibiotics. If you sought help for a runny nose, the probability increased to two in three. "When antibiotics were prescribed, there appeared to be little rhyme or reason to guide their selection," the researchers said.

In such a case, you use the imperative form, which means using just the verb without a subject. To change imperative sentences into Indirect Speech, replace the verbs of reporting verb.

Here, the correct indirect form of the given sentence is "The doctor advised him to avoid unhealthy food.""

questions.q_en:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Sarah said, "I have been baking for hours."
options_en: Sarah said that she has been baking for hours.
Sarah said that she had been baking for hours.
Sarah said that she was baking for hours.
Sarah said that she would have been baking for hours.
questions.solution_en:
The sentence in the Direct Speech is in Present Perfect Continuous Tense. Therefore, the sentence in the Indirect Speech should be in Past Perfect Continuous Tense.

Present Perfect Continuous (Subject + has/have + been + V1 + ing + Object) should be converted into Past Perfect Continuous (Subject + had + been + V1 + ing + Object).

For example:

He said, "We have been waiting for hours." (Direct Speech)

He said that they had been waiting for hours. (Indirect Speech)

The following things in the sentence should change when changed from Direct speech to Indirect Speech:

"Said" changes to "said that".

"I" changes "she".

"have" changes to "had".

Therefore, the correct answer is: "Sarah said that she had been baking for hours."

Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.q_en:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It can occur spontaneously or as the result of seeing or hearing a yawn, called contagious yawning.

B. They are increasing blood flow to the head, oxygenating, and cooling the brain.

C. Most of the research on spontaneous yawning points to a physiological function.

D. Though yawning is an instantly recognizable behaviour shared among most vertebrate animals, scientists still don't know enough about this seemingly simple phenomenon.
questions.solution_en:
The subject of the passage 'yawning' is introduced in sentence D. Hence, it will be placed first in the sequence.

A builds up on the subject by stating the ways in which the process takes place and also introduces 'contagious yawning'. Hence, A should follow D.

C should follow A as it tells us about research on 'spontaneous yawning' and what type of process it is.

B enlists the 'physiological function' mentioned in C; hence, B should follow C.

The sequence after rearrangement will be DACB.

Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

I am eagerly anticipating the joyous experience at your party and looking forward to dance and immerse myself in the rhythm, movements, and sheer delight of the moment.
questions.solution_en:
There are many expressions such as - 'looking forward to, accustomed to, averse to, object to, prior to, etc.' that are commonly followed by a gerund. Also, when two verbs are connected with 'and,' they should be in the same form, which in this case would be the gerund.

So, the use of 'dancing and immersing' is appropriate here.

No other option follows this rule.

The correct sentence is - "I am eagerly anticipating the joyous experience at your party and looking forward to dancing and immersing myself in the rhythm, movements, and sheer delight of the moment."

Hence, option (c) is correct.

Note:

Gerund: Gerund is a verb form that functions as a noun, ending in -ing. A gerund can be either the subject or object of a sentence in English. Example: "Everybody enjoyed her dancing and singing at the party." The words 'dancing' and 'singing' are gerunds.

questions.q_en:
Select the option that can be used as a one word substitute for the given group of words.

An often-imaginary place or state of utter perfection and happiness
questions.solution_en:
A utopia refers to an imaginary place or state of ideal perfection in terms of laws, governance, and happiness. It is often used to describe an ideal society where everything is perfect. The term was popularized by Sir Thomas More's book Utopia in 1516.

Inferno: A place of intense heat or hell.

Dystopia: An imagined state of great suffering or injustice, often the opposite of utopia.

Euphoria: A feeling of intense happiness or excitement.
